# A page that names only generic placeholders

Install under `/home/user/` — the generic form a placeholder is for, and the
ancestor-dir example `/home/AGENTS.md` is a filename, not an account.

Clone the seed with `git clone https://github.com/acme/cypress.git`, point a
probe at loopback 127.0.0.1, and use a documentation address such as 192.0.2.10.

Redact a real install path to `/root/…` and a Windows home to `C:\Users\Public\`.
